description: This PHP source file defines the ExternalOAuthConnection class, which manages OAuth connections within SuiteCRM, including access control, retrieval, saving, and query creation functionalities.
external_files: SugarCRM core files (implied by parent class and global variables)

classes.name: ExternalOAuthConnection
classes.description: Represents an OAuth connection entity with methods for access control, retrieval, saving, and query filtering within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a record by ID, with access check for personal account.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the record, with access check for personal account.

methods.name: hasAccessToPersonalAccount
methods.description: Determines if the current user has access to a personal account.

methods.name: logPersonalAccountAccessDenied
methods.description: Logs an access denied event for personal account attempts.

methods.name: ACLAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to perform a specific view/action.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Creates a filtered list query considering user permissions and group ACLs.

methods.name: keepWriteOnlyFieldValues
methods.description: Preserves write-only field values during record updates.

methods.name: isAdminOnlyAction
methods.description: Checks if a view/action is restricted to admin users.

methods.name: isSecurityGroupBasedAction
methods.description: Checks if a view/action is security group based.

methods.name: isNotAllowedAction
methods.description: Checks if a view/action is explicitly not allowed.
